metadata.name: Room Cleaner
metadata.description:
[h2]💥 Automatic Room Cleaning[/h2] Automatically destroys supported environmental objects when entering a room, including:
[list] [*]Rocks and tinted rocks [*]Bomb rocks and golden rocks [*]Mushrooms and pots [*]Skulls and tinted skulls [*]Poop [*]TNT [*]Spikes and other supported grid objects [*]Fireplaces [*]Shopkeepers, including hanging variants [/list]
Destruction uses the game's damage and destruction mechanics wherever supported, rather than simply making objects disappear.
[h2]🧲 Massive Pickup Magnet[/h2] The magnet attracts nearby pickups towards your character, even across massive rooms.
Currently supported: [list] [*]Coins [*]Bombs [*]Keys [*]Grab Bags (Sacks) [/list]
[h2]👹 Kill All Enemies[/h2] Press [b]C[/b] to instantly kill all active enemies in the current room.
[h2]🚪 Boss Room Teleport[/h2] Press [b]Left Shift[/b] to teleport directly to the boss room on the current floor.
